Figure 1:Interactive Visual Gym.(a) System overview: The visual interaction model under evaluation is tasked with
guiding a simulated user to complete a physical task in a visual environment.
(b) Examples showing how different task execution can be simulated based on different assistant response.

Figure 2:Example tasks in our environments.We show the simulated tasks across three domains, with representative
action commands and corresponding visual observations during task execution. Our semantic action spaces express actions at the level of
everyday human communication.
Figure 6:Qualitative examples of assistant interaction trajectories.It illustrates recurring problems across assistant types that our dynamic evaluation expose.
Figure 7:Qualitative example from RL.The base assistant misperceives the task state and fails to prevent the error. After RL, the assistant gives timely guidance that prevents the error.
